mentions.name: Burrito
mentions.description: Open source TACoS (Terraform automation and collaboration software) that empowers infrastructure as code with drift detection, contribution workflows, and a comprehensive UI, built as a Kubernetes-based platform strongly inspired by ArgoCD.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on an open source TACoS (Terraform automation and collaboration software) called Burrito.  
Our goal is to empower infrastructure as code with drift detection, contribution workflows and a comprehensive UI, all in a Kubernetes based software strongly inspired by ArgoCD.
